transitions.semanticPurpose: Carry the work packet across boards.
transitions.stateChange: The work packet changes from queued to validated.
transitions.attentionHandoff: The viewer follows the work packet along a shared grid baseline.
transitions.styleContinuity: Square rectangles, hard-edge masks, zero-padding boxes, and grayscale hierarchy persist.
transitions.alignmentRule: Outgoing and incoming work packet boxes share a grid row baseline.
transitions.edgeRule: All masks and panels remain square, rectangular, hard-edge, and 0-radius.
transitions.boxPaddingRule: All boxes keep internalPaddingPx 0; content remains flush to bounds with external gutters only.
transitions.genericMotionRejected: A generic slide is wrong because it hides the work packet state change.
transitions.surprise: The work packet becomes the validation row.
transitions.outgoingState: Queued work packet is visible on the source board.
transitions.bridgeAction: Work packet stretches along the grid baseline with flush bounds.
transitions.incomingState: Validated work packet lands as the primary rectangle on the target board.
transitions.compositionShift: Left board becomes right board through shared grid baseline.
transitions.cameraShift: No camera move; orthogonal morph holds scale.

validationFrames.passCriterion: This should fail because grayscale hierarchy is not structured.
